statements.text: Aluminium is malleable because it flattens into a sheet.
Coal is brittle because it breaks into pieces.
Wood is brittle because it did not flatten into a sheet.

stem:
Diya places samples on a hard surface and beats each with a hammer. An aluminium strip flattens into a thinner sheet. A lump of coal breaks into pieces. A wooden block neither flattens into a sheet nor breaks into pieces in this test.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Flattening shows malleability; breaking shows brittleness. Wood that neither flattens nor breaks is neither malleable nor brittle in this test.
